Container.Name: calibre-bookwarden
Container.Overview: Calibre Bookwarden is the content-grounded metadata verification and cover forensics guardian for Calibre libraries. The book file is the ground truth, LLMs are witnesses. Zero hallucinations, read-only 360-degree forensic audits, Cover Deck swipeable UI, Series Gap Hunter, and surgical rollbacks.
Container.DonateText: Support Calibre Bookwarden development via GitHub Sponsors or Ko-fi

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for WebUI and REST API (Host maps 8084 to container 8080 to prevent conflicts)

Config.Name: Calibre Library Path
Config.Description: Path to your Calibre Library root containing metadata.db

Config.Name: Library Environment Path
Config.Description: Path where Calibre library is mounted inside container

Config.Name: Config & Artifacts Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for audit reports, restore points, and SQLite DB

Config.Name: Database Backend
Config.Description: Database backend for state and audits (sqlite or postgres)

Config.Name: Artifacts Directory
Config.Description: Path to persistent artifacts and restore points directory

Config.Name: Queue Backend
Config.Description: Queue backend for standalone homelab (memory or valkey)

Config.Name: Rate Limits Backend
Config.Description: Rate limit backend for standalone homelab (memory or valkey)

Config.Name: Read Only Mode
Config.Description: When true, mutations are strictly blocked (safe for zero-risk inspection)

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Google Gemini API Key for multimodal cover verification (Gemini 3.8 Flash)

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Optional OpenAI API Key for fallback LLM witness

Config.Name: Calibre-Web Container Name
Config.Description: Docker container name for Calibre-Web thumbnail cache purge

Config.Name: Calibre-Web URL
Config.Description: HTTP URL to Calibre-Web instance for zero-downtime hot-reload
